description: WP-O6 Codex: Orks (11e) MIGHT IS RIGHT (Warboss, passive): after a charge move this turn its melee weapons have +3 A and +2 S. Fixture ork11e_ab_fight: the Warboss charged (charged_this_turn) and is engaged with the Shield-Captain. A real click on 'Fight' for the Warboss, attacks assigned and resolved through the real dialogs: every melee hit roll the Warboss made shows 3 more attacks than the weapon's profile per model. Setup privileges: auto wound allocation, the Custodes' wounds inflated (the fight must not end the scenario).
